richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Kavali

c: Kavali is a coastal town in Nellore district. We keep our advice for it to what we are sure of: sandy coastal soil, humid air and a monsoon that comes late in the year. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to schools, colleges, housing layouts and municipal parks in Kavali. Our machines are made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 900 km away, and travel by road to coastal Andhra.

Sandy soil can shift under a loose base, so we usually suggest grouting each machine into a concrete footing. Humid, slightly salty air is the other thing to plan for, which is why our frames are galvanised. The north-east monsoon brings most of the rain here from October. Our installers or a dealer in south India fix the machines. Send photos of the site and we will prepare a layout drawing.
A deep, grouted footing holds the machine level in sand. The
work well in a park where several people exercise together, and a Leg Press adds strength work.

items.q: How are outdoor gym machines fixed on sandy soil?
items.a: We grout each base in a concrete footing set deep enough to stay firm in sand. This keeps the machine level through wet and dry seasons.

items.q: Does coastal air affect the machines in Kavali?
items.a: Humid, salty air is hard on bare steel, which is why our frames are galvanised. Rinse the machines with fresh water from time to time.

items.q: Do you supply outdoor gyms in Kavali?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch from our factory in Vasai by road and install through our own team or a dealer in south India.
